personality_one_liner: A highly readable, camera-first utility framing the real world with minimal chrome and clear typography.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content, distinct visual separation between camera view and floating HUD controls.

do's: Use heavily tinted glass for top language selectors floating over the camera.
Use frosted glass on the bottom control bar to maintain camera context.
dont's: Don't use blur on translated text bounding boxes; those need solid backgrounds for readability.

screens.name: Live Camera (Home)
screens.purpose: Primary AR translation surface combining real-time camera feed with translated text overlays.

states.loading: Camera initializing with a subtle pulse animation.
states.empty: No text detected - clear camera view with a persistent 'Scanning for text...' floating badge.
states.error: Camera permission denied or network error - frosted overlay with readable error message and primary retry button.

screens.layout: Camera feed covers `flex: 1` as absolute background. Top Safe Area contains a frosted glass pill-shaped language selector (Source Auto-Detect -> Target Pick) anchored to the top. A draggable bounding box viewport floats in the center using PanGestureHandler. At the bottom, a floating frosted glass sheet contains the History button, Settings toggle (Light/Dark), and Capture/Translate action. Detected text bounding boxes are rendered absolutely over the camera with a solid `surfaceSecondary` background and `onSurface` text, exactly matching the scale/position of the source text.

screens.name: Language Picker (Modal)
screens.purpose: Full-screen or large bottom sheet for selecting the target translation language from a list of 100+.
screens.layout: Vertical list view with a sticky search bar at the top. List items are a minimum 56pt tall. Current selected language has a checkbox or strong highlight on the right. Avoid flags for languages (often politically complex); stick to localized text names.

screens.name: Translation History
screens.purpose: Archive of past translations for user reference.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of an open notebook with 'No translations yet' text.
states.error: Failed to load history - Retry button.

screens.layout: Standard scrolling vertical list. Each row displays the original text and translated text with a subtle date stamp. 'Clear All' button placed at the top right of the navigation header.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an AR-style Utility application. The layout should prioritize the camera viewfinder. Use `expo-camera` or equivalent.
Implement light and dark mode toggling directly in the Settings or Bottom HUD, dynamically switching the theme.
Bounding boxes rendered over the camera feed MUST use a solid background (not blurred) so the translated text is highly readable against random real-world backgrounds.
Use Phosphor icons. Ensure the top language selector is a prominent, pill-shaped frosted glass button that's easily reachable.
For the draggable camera viewport, use `react-native-reanimated` and `react-native-gesture-handler` for a buttery-smooth 60fps pan/drag interaction.
Display descriptive feedback loops (e.g., 'Detecting text...', 'Translating via Gemini...') rather than a generic spinner.
Use Sage Green (`brand` tokens) for accents. Blue is strictly banned per rules.
